Hon’ble Siddhartha Sah, J.
Mr. Dushyant Mainali, Advocate for the petitioner. 
2. Mr. N.K. Papnoi and Mr. Suyash Pant, S.C.s’ for 
the State.
3. Counter affidavit, if any, to be filed within three 
weeks.
4. Since similarly situated petitioners have filed 
petitions before this Court, namely WPSS Nos.159 of 
2026 and 235 of 2026, an interim order in terms of the 
orders dated 27.01.2026 and 30.01.2026 is called for.
5. List this case on 27.02.2026 along with WPSS 
No.242 of 2026 and 243 of 2026.
6. In the meantime, one post of Assistant Teacher
(Science), Primary School, under O.B.C. Category shall 
be kept vacant for the petitioner in District Almora, 
under O.B.C. Category in case the posts are not filled 
up.
7. Urgency Application (IA No.1 of 2026) and Interim 
Relief Application (IA No.2 of 2026) stand disposed of 
accordingly.
 (Siddhartha Sah, J.)
